title: Remarkably Vanilla
description: Remarkably Vanilla, your go to for a nice and simple vanilla Minecraft experience.
body: Remarkably Vanilla is a Minecraft modpack made for players who love the original game and want it to feel just a little better without changing what makes it special. It keeps everything familiar, from world generation to survival gameplay, but adds small tweaks that improve performance, visuals, and quality of life so the game feels smoother and more polished. There is no new content that breaks immersion, and all vanilla mechanics still work the way you expect, making it perfect for long term worlds, building projects, and players who want a clean, reliable Minecraft experience that feels like vanilla at its best.
